voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Off Florida, December nineteen forty-five. Five Navy torpedo bombers, fourteen men, flew a routine training flight. None came back.
Their leader radioed: "Both of my compasses are out." He was sure he was over the Keys.
Among his last messages: "When the first plane drops below ten gallons, we all go down together."
Thirteen men went searching in a flying boat. Minutes later, a tanker reported a burst of flames, and a pool of oil.
Hundreds of ships and planes searched for five days. The Navy's finding: cause unknown. No wreckage has ever been identified.
